description: The same floating ceiling on resin-msla, whose profile allows supports: a warning (turn on supports) instead of a blocker. No fit profile, as the bundled one is for fdm-0.4.

findings.fix: turn on supports in the slicer for this part, or chamfer the overhang at 45 degrees so it needs none
findings.message: 1 region of downward faces hangs up to 90° from vertical, beyond the 60° maxOverhangDeg of process `resin-msla`, without a short bridge (it has no material below any edge); the steepest is 2 mm above the bed near x 8 mm, y 16 mm in print orientation

unchecked.reason: no printer or bed was given, so the part was not checked against a build volume; choose a printer (openbrick validate --printer, or the playground's printer menu) or give a bed (--bed WxDxH)
